ICULOS.description: Original hourly predictor. Required observed time coordinate.

HR__previous.description: Value at the preceding hour after bounded causal forward filling.

HR__delta.description: Current minus preceding-hour value after bounded causal forward filling.

HR__hours_since_observed.description: Hours since last original observation; -1 if never observed.

HR__mean_3h.description: mean of original observations in (ICULOS-3, ICULOS]; includes current hour, excludes future hours and forward-filled values.

HR__min_3h.description: min of original observations in (ICULOS-3, ICULOS]; includes current hour, excludes future hours and forward-filled values.

HR__max_3h.description: max of original observations in (ICULOS-3, ICULOS]; includes current hour, excludes future hours and forward-filled values.

HR__std_3h.description: std of original observations in (ICULOS-3, ICULOS]; includes current hour, excludes future hours and forward-filled values. Population standard deviation; requires at least 2 observations.

HR__slope_3h.description: slope of original observations in (ICULOS-3, ICULOS]; includes current hour, excludes future hours and forward-filled values. OLS slope per hour; requires at least 2 observations.
